paper_title: How Knowledge Popularity Influences and Enhances LLM Knowledge Boundary   Perception
caption: The QA performance, confidence, and alignment of Qwen2 under different answer popularity.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
The line graph illustrates the relationship between question popularity and three key metrics: accuracy, confidence, and alignment for the Qwen2-7B model on a basketball-related task. The x-axis, labeled "Question Popularity," is linearly scaled and ranges from 0 to 300, with major ticks at intervals of 50. The y-axis, labeled "Values," is also linearly scaled and spans from 0.0 to 1.0, with major ticks at intervals of 0.2.

The graph features three distinct lines, each representing one of the metrics: accuracy (blue), confidence (green), and alignment (red). The accuracy line starts at approximately 0.1 when question popularity is 0, decreases slightly until around 100, then increases sharply to about 0.4 at a question popularity of 217. It subsequently decreases to around 0.3 at a question popularity of 288. The confidence line remains relatively stable, starting at approximately 0.75 and fluctuating between 0.7 and 0.8 across the range of question popularity. The alignment line begins at around 0.3, decreases slightly until a question popularity of 83, then gradually increases to about 0.6 at a question popularity of 217, before decreasing to approximately 0.55 at a question popularity of 288.

The y-axis is labeled "Values," also has a linear scale, and ranges from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. Three lines are plotted: "Accuracy" in blue with a solid line and circular markers, starting at approximately 0.08 at a question popularity of 10, decreasing to around 0.0 at a popularity of 50, then increasing to about 0.4 at a popularity of 225 before decreasing to roughly 0.3 at a popularity of 290; "Confidence" in green with a solid line and triangular markers, beginning at approximately 0.73 at a popularity of 10, fluctuating between 0.7 and 0.8 throughout the range; and "Alignment" in red with a solid line and square markers, starting at around 0.33 at a popularity of 10, decreasing to about 0.25 at a popularity of 100, then rising to approximately 0.6 at a popularity of 225 before decreasing to roughly 0.55 at a popularity of 290.
